items.text: fixed: The line that shows how long a sound lasts now starts exactly at the shape's edge. Triangles were measured at their far corner, which left a gap at the line's height; rings were a little off too.

Send held notes to the field. With any note held, a new button appears beside the pencil. Each held note becomes a field sound at its own pitch (in Wall view the height is the pitch; in Floor view it takes its scale step), drawn as the same mark inside a halo, in its own colour. The note stops being held; the mark stays on the grid.
fixed: The line that shows how long a note lasts now starts at the edge of its own shape (dot, bar, triangle, ring, pair or square), not at a fixed distance, so it touches the mark.
fixed: The level panel of a held note now fits its cell whatever the shape (it left gaps or floated when the steps were different sizes).
fixed: 0.5.28 did not start (a typing slip in a hint). Fixed.

In the Floor view, hold a Field sound for half a second: it swells and shows its note number. Drag up or down to change that sound's note, from 1 to the top of the scale. Let go without dragging for its menu, as before. Dragging a sound straight away still moves it.
changed: The Floor note label is in plain words.
Hold the load meter and the Soniscale settings now include Marked moments: how many you have marked, with Copy report, Email report and Clear marks.
fixed: Marking a moment no longer makes the system check say something is wrong; marks and sound load are listed as information in the report.
changed: Computers can now keep up to 120 sounds at once (was 60), and the limit climbs back faster when the machine is calm. Phones and tablets are unchanged.
